hooks.name: Lint & Format Check on Python Save
hooks.description: Runs ruff check and format verification on Python files after save to catch style issues immediately, following code-style steering conventions.

action.command: ruff check --select E,F,I,N,W,UP,Y,B,A,C4,PT --line-length 100 --target-version py312 "${file}" && ruff format --check --line-length 100 "${file}"
